title: AEHR TEST SYSTEMS 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: AEHR Test Systems (AEHR), a semiconductor test equipment company headquartered in Fremont, CA, entered into an Equity Distribution Agreement with William Blair and Craig-Hallum Capital Group on April 8, 2026, establishing an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering facility for up to $60,000,000 in common stock shares. The offering is registered under an S-3 shelf declared effective October 25, 2024, with agents entitled to commissions up to 3.0% of gross proceeds.
key_points: AEHR Test Systems signed an Equity Distribution Agreement on April 8, 2026 with William Blair & Company and Craig-Hallum Capital Group as sales agents.
The ATM facility allows for the offer and sale of up to $60,000,000 in common stock shares.
The offering is registered under Form S-3 (File No. 333-282661), effective October 25, 2024.
Agents will receive a commission of up to 3.0% of gross proceeds from share sales.
The company is not obligated to make any sales, and agents are not required to sell any specific amount.
A prospectus supplement was filed with the SEC on April 8, 2026.
why_it_matters: This is a routine equity capital markets transaction for a mid-cap semiconductor equipment company. The filing provides legal documentation of the ATM facility terms. The company retains full discretion over timing and amount of sales, meaning no immediate dilutive impact unless and until shares are sold.
